turns.text: What if patient does not share any ABHA Address with the health facility?

must_contain: the patient can register at the facility by giving name, date of birth, gender and mobile number
the health facility notifies the HIE-CM of a new health record for that mobile number
no health record type or demographic detail is shared in that notification, only an SMS is sent to the patient
notes: catalogue gap: the walk in patient registration flow without an existing ABHA address, and the resulting SMS notification, is not documented
